invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata instance, so result should not be null.
preppedRecords is passed to the underlying executor and should not be null at method exit.
instantTime is required for versioning and is always expected to be non-null.
context is used for engine operations and is not allowed to be null in Hudi table methods.
The method guarantees that the result is of type HoodieWriteMetadata.
